subject: Re: Redwood follow-up: procurement & marketplace path (AWS) - next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmecloud.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood follow-up: procurement & marketplace path (AWS) - next steps

Hi Liam / Sara,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and appreciate the clarity on the integration and SLA expectations. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can align with your procurement team: 

Recap from our call:
- Primary use: real-time inference for customer-facing features (low-latency reads).
- Expected monthly token volume: ~1.2B tokens (peaky usage).
- Security: SOC 2 in place; you requested details on data residency and KMS integration.

Procurement / commercial questions we discussed:
1) Marketplace vs PO/card: you mentioned a preference for buying through AWS Marketplace if Redwood is available there (easier internal approvals). If marketplace isn't an option, procurement needs to issue a formal PO and route via their AP process. Can you confirm which path Procurement prefers?
2) Paper process & SOW: does AcmeCloud require an SOW and/or a Master Services Agreement up front, or do you typically proceed with a PO and attach a standard SOW later?
3) Contract owners & timeline: who on your side will review legal/contract redlines and what timeline should we expect (1–3 weeks typical)?

Proposed next steps:
- I can share a draft SOW + PO template for your procurement team to review (attached).
- If AWS Marketplace is preferred, Marissa (cc'd) can scope the listing/private-offer path and share timelines.
- Neha (cc'd) is our contracts lead — she can be looped in for any redlines.

Attachments: PO-template_AcmeCloud.docx, Redwood_SOW-draft-v1.pdf

Would you prefer we pursue an AWS Marketplace private offer first, or should we start a PO & SOW cadence?

Thanks,
Camila
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
www.redwood.ai

----

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmecloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@acmecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood follow-up: procurement & marketplace path (AWS) - next steps

Hi Camila — thanks for the summary. Short answers below: 

1) Marketplace vs PO/card: Our procurement team prefers Marketplace purchases when available because it maps to our procurement tooling and avoids vendor onboarding. So AWS Marketplace would be ideal. If Redwood can do a private offer (POA) or listing, that will be faster for us.

2) Paper process & SOW: We generally accept a PO + standard SOW. Legal will only request an MSA in special cases. If a short SOW that lists deliverables and SLAs is provided, procurement is happy.

3) Contract owners & timeline: Sara (cc) is the procurement lead and will review. Typical lead time for a private offer through AWS is ~1 week to approve; for a standard PO route it's closer to 2–3 weeks due to vendor onboarding.

Notes:
- We do need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a brief doc on KMS integration — happy to accept attachments or an upload link.
- Data residency: US-only is fine for this project.

Happy to proceed with the AWS Marketplace private offer as first preference. If you can coordinate with Marissa on Marketplace listing/private offer steps, we can move quickly.

Thanks,
Liam
Director of Product | AcmeCloud
liam.oconnor@acmecloud.com

----

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmecloud.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 12:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood follow-up: procurement & marketplace path (AWS) - next steps

Perfect — thanks for the quick clarity, Liam. Looping in Marissa and Neha to start both tracks in parallel:

- Marissa: can you confirm estimated timeline to publish a private offer on AWS Marketplace (or confirm if we can support a Private Offer/Bring Your Own License flow)? In our experience a private offer + doc workflow typically takes ~3–7 business days on the sales/marketplace side, plus procurement approval.

- Neha: I'll share the SOW + PO template now; can you flag any clauses that typically slow approvals for marketplace/private-offer customers so we can preempt them?

Liam / Sara — I'll send a quick set of SOC 2 artifacts and a short KMS integration note in a separate email (or you can share a secure upload).

Next step: Marissa will follow up with a marketplace timeline and a proposed private-offer flow; I'll also send the SOW/PO as editable docs so Sara's team can attach/route them.

Camila

----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmecloud.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood follow-up: procurement & marketplace path (AWS) - next steps

Hi all — thanks Camila / Liam. Quick marketplace/ops note from Redwood Marketplace ops: 

- We can support an AWS Marketplace Private Offer for AcmeCloud. Typical internal lead time: 3–5 business days to generate the private offer once commercial terms are agreed (price, billing cadence).
- For the marketplace flow we need: an approved pricing sheet, the billing account ARN (from AcmeCloud), and confirmation whether Acme wants consolidated billing or standalone.
- If procurement prefers a direct PO, we can accept that via our AP team. PO route will require our vendor onboarding (W9, bank details) which usually adds ~7 business days initial lead time.

I'll start by prepping a private-offer checklist and will send the DocuSign/Marketplace packet once we have a price. Camila — can you confirm the proposed list price and term? I can then associate the private offer and generate the DocuSign envelope.

Marissa Cole
Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: marketplace-private-offer-checklist.pdf

----

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmecloud.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 16:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood follow-up: procurement & marketplace path (AWS) - next steps

Thanks Marissa / Camila — that all sounds good. Action items from our side:
- I'll share the billing account ARN and internal PO template by EOD Monday.
- We prefer consolidated billing under our org account.
- Our legal will do a quick review of the SOW; please send a short-version SOW and the KMS integration note.

If you can send the private-offer checklist and a proposed price sheet, we'll prioritize the marketplace private offer route.

Sara Patel
Procurement Lead | AcmeCloud
sara.patel@acmecloud.com
